name: ui-test
description: Agent-run UI tests for any macOS app with a window — native Swift/SwiftUI apps, FileMaker Pro, Electron: The orchestrator writes a typed test instruction, a Codex computer-use worker runs it under Ringer and returns an evidence receipt (screenshots + values read off the screen), executed checks validate the receipt, and a separate verifier issues the verdict. Outcomes PASS-OBSERVED / FAIL / BLOCKED. Per-app target profiles (FileMaker, native macOS) carry the approval, preconditions and non-UI channel. Requires Ringer and a one-time Codex computer-use approval per app.
